failure_patterns.symptom: Paste command returns without a new figure or image in the Note editor DOM.
failure_patterns.cause: The browser clipboard route does not deliver image data into the editor reliably.
failure_patterns.stopline: Do not keep pasting through the same browser clipboard route after two failures.
failure_patterns.next_action: Return to a fresh DOM audit, then choose supervised OS clipboard, visible file dialog, or manual upload.

failure_patterns.symptom: The native pipe closes or the clipboard bridge errors before the editor receives the image.
failure_patterns.cause: The automation bridge is unavailable or unstable in the current browser/editor surface.
failure_patterns.stopline: Treat the route as closed for this article after the repeated native pipe failure.
failure_patterns.next_action: Do not retry blindly; switch to a visible, supervised route or stop with manual instructions.

failure_patterns.symptom: One upload action later produces multiple new figures or delayed figure changes.
failure_patterns.cause: The Note editor may apply pending upload actions asynchronously, so count-based success can be stale.
failure_patterns.stopline: Stop additional uploads immediately and re-audit every figure by nearby SS number and dimensions.
failure_patterns.next_action: Recompute missing, duplicate, and mismatched images before the next single-image cycle.

failure_patterns.symptom: The extension or wrapper cannot pass a local file directly to input[type=file].
failure_patterns.cause: The visible Chrome extension surface does not expose a reliable file-input API for this flow.
failure_patterns.stopline: Do not mark input discovery as upload success and do not assume a hidden attach worked.
failure_patterns.next_action: Use a visible file dialog, supervised OS clipboard, or manual upload boundary.

failure_patterns.symptom: The Chrome extension opens the Note image file chooser but setFiles fails with Not allowed.
failure_patterns.cause: The Codex Chrome extension cannot read local files until Chrome extension file URL access is enabled.
failure_patterns.stopline: Do not retry the same filechooser upload route in the same article cycle until extension file access is enabled or another supervised route is chosen.
failure_patterns.next_action: Record no-insert verification, keep the draft open at the target heading, then use manual upload, supervised OS clipboard paste, or enable Chrome extension file URL access.

failure_patterns.symptom: The cursor, selection, or target placeholder is not uniquely tied to the intended SS location.
failure_patterns.cause: The editor DOM and visible selection can drift after scrolling, delayed render, or prior manual edits.
failure_patterns.stopline: Do not paste, delete, drag, or upload while the insertion point is ambiguous.
failure_patterns.next_action: Re-read the DOM, identify a unique heading or placeholder, and run a cursor-prep-only cycle.

failure_patterns.symptom: The current URL, title, or live DOM no longer matches the pre-action snapshot, or the intended result is already complete.
failure_patterns.cause: Navigation, autosave, delayed rendering, a human action, or an earlier submit changed the page state.
failure_patterns.stopline: Discard the old locator and do not repeat submit, create, publish, or send while the current state is unresolved.
failure_patterns.next_action: Re-run tab inventory and read-only attach, capture URL/title/fresh DOM, then classify the state as state-transition-detected or already-completed.

failure_patterns.symptom: A cycle starts from previous memory, old figure counts, or an old cursor position.
failure_patterns.cause: The Note draft can be changed by the user, autosave, delayed upload, or another browser surface.
failure_patterns.stopline: Abort the cycle before any write and rebuild the current state from the live DOM.
failure_patterns.next_action: Run read-only attach/audit first, then create a new one-action work packet.
